brief:
Israeli settlers smashed the foundations of two homes belonging to a Palestinian family in the occupied West Bank on Thursday, Middle East Eye reported. The demolition followed earlier settler attacks that had prevented the family from returning to their property.

The incident is part of a broader pattern of settler violence targeting Palestinian communities across the occupied territory. Attacks on Palestinian homes and property have intensified in recent months, displacing families and destroying livelihoods.
